hypothesis: A fixed-budget endpoint can answer held-out development prompts using the same bounded PurePosixPath operations.
limitations: Inputs and wording are held out from adaptation, but every case remains within the shared lexical operations and answer grammar. This is development evidence on unseen literals/wording, not frozen confirmation or independent semantic generalization. It must not select a checkpoint, seed, or rerun. The 0.0 controls are deliberate non-claims: this finite authored oracle-answer pool supplies no open-vocabulary chance baseline. Literal scoring trims only outer reply whitespace; case, Unicode composition, and internal whitespace remain significant.
